salmanshh_simple_health.name: Simple Health
salmanshh_simple_health.description: Health for any object: damage, healing, death and revive, shield and armour health pools, and status effects like burn, poison and regen in real time or turns.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.desc: Write health events, and actions that were ignored, to the browser console to help find mistakes in events. Turn off for release.

maxHealth.name: Max Health
maxHealth.desc: Initial maximum health for instances with this behavior.

destroyOnDeath.name: Destroy on Death
destroyOnDeath.desc: Destroy the instance when it dies.

clearStatusesOnDeath.name: Clear Statuses on Death
clearStatusesOnDeath.desc: Remove all active statuses when the instance dies.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: When disabled, damage, healing and new statuses are ignored, and pool decay and status timers pause.

Heal.description: Increase health by the specified amount (up to max health).

Revive.description: Revive the instance. Use -1 to restore to max health, or specify an amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.desc: Health to restore on revive. Use -1 to restore to max health.

SetEnabled.description: Enable or disable the behavior. Disabled ignores damage, healing and new statuses, and pauses timers.

state.name: State
state.desc: Whether the behavior processes damage, healing and statuses.

SetHealth.description: Set the instance's current health (clamped between 0 and max).

SetHealthAbsorptionRate.description: Set the multiplier applied to damage that reaches real health. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = 50% damage taken (resistance), 2.0 = double damage taken (vulnerability), 0 = immune.

rate.name: Rate
rate.desc: Damage multiplier for real health (e.g. 0.5 = half damage taken, 2.0 = double damage taken).

SetInvulnerable.description: Set whether the instance is invulnerable to damage.

state.name: Invulnerable
state.desc: True to make invulnerable, false to allow damage.

TakeDamage.description: Reduce health by the specified amount.

amount.name: Amount
amount.desc: The amount of damage to take.

AdvanceStatusTurns.description: Advance all turn-based statuses: tick, drain stacks and expire them.

count.name: Turns
count.desc: Number of turns to advance (whole number, at least 1).

ApplyStatus.description: Apply or reapply a status for a duration in seconds or turns.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

duration.name: Duration
duration.desc: How long the status lasts, in the chosen unit. Use -1 for permanent.

unit.name: Unit
unit.desc: Seconds count down automatically. Turns only count down with 'Advance status turns'.

stacks.name: Stacks
stacks.desc: Number of stacks to add (whole number, at least 1).

ClearAllStatuses.description: Remove every active status, firing On status (Removed) for each.

RemoveStatus.description: Remove a status immediately, firing On status (Removed).

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

RemoveStatusStacks.description: Remove stacks from a status. Reaching 0 stacks removes the status.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

SetStatusModifier.description: Set a multiplier the status applies while active. Several statuses multiply together.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "corrode"). Not case-sensitive.

modifier.name: Modifier
modifier.desc: Health pool absorption: multiplies every health pool's absorption rate (2 = pools drain twice as fast).

value.name: Multiplier
value.desc: 1 = no change, 2 = double, 0.5 = half, 0 = pools never deplete from damage.

SetStatusRemaining.description: Set the time remaining on an active status, in its unit. 0 expires it, -1 makes it permanent.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

value.name: Time remaining
value.desc: Seconds or turns left (matches the status unit). 0 expires it, -1 = permanent.

SetStatusStacking.display-text: {my}: Set status {0} stacking: max {1}, reapply mode {2}, lose {3} stack(s) per tick
SetStatusStacking.description: Set how a status stacks and how its duration reacts to reapplying.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

reapplyMode.name: Reapply mode
reapplyMode.desc: Refresh resets the duration, Extend adds to it, Keep leaves it unchanged.

stacksLostPerTick.name: Stacks lost per tick
stacksLostPerTick.desc: Stacks removed after each tick. 0 = stacks never drain.

SetStatusTick.display-text: {my}: Set status {0} to {1} {2} per stack every {3}
SetStatusTick.description: Set how often a status ticks and the damage or healing each tick applies.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status (e.g. "burn", "poison"). Not case-sensitive.

periodicType.name: Type
periodicType.desc: What each tick does. Damage goes through health pools and absorption rate.

amountPerStack.name: Amount per stack
amountPerStack.desc: Amount per tick, multiplied by the current stacks.

interval.name: Interval
interval.desc: Tick every N seconds or turns (matches the status unit). 0 = no ticks.

AddTempHealth.description: Add health to a named health pool.

amount.name: Amount
amount.desc: The amount of pool health to add.

ClearAllTempHealth.description: Empty every health pool on this instance.

type.name: Pool
type.desc: Name of the health pool to clear.

SetPoolAbsorptionMultiplier.display-text: {my}: Set health pool absorption multiplier to {0}
SetPoolAbsorptionMultiplier.description: Multiply every health pool's absorption rate without changing the rates themselves.

multiplier.name: Multiplier
multiplier.desc: 1 = normal, 2 = pools drain twice as fast, 0.5 = half as fast, 0 = pools never deplete from damage.

SetTempHealth.description: Set a named health pool to a specific amount.

SetTempHealthAbsorptionRate.display-text: {my}: Set health pool {0} absorption rate to {1}
SetTempHealthAbsorptionRate.description: Set pool health lost per 1 damage. 1 = equal, 0.5 = armour-style, 2 = fragile.

rate.name: Rate
rate.desc: Pool health lost per 1 point of damage (e.g. 0.5 = armour-style).

SetTempHealthDecayRate.display-text: {my}: Set health pool {0} decay rate to {1} per second
SetTempHealthDecayRate.description: Set how much a health pool drains per second. 0 disables decay.

rate.name: Rate
rate.desc: Pool health lost per second (0 = no decay).

SetTempHealthPriority.description: Set a pool's absorption priority. Lower numbers absorb damage first. Default 0.

priority.name: Priority
priority.desc: Damage absorption priority. Lower numbers are consumed first.

SetTempHealthRates.display-text: {my}: Set health pool {0} rates: decay {1}/s, absorption {2}
SetTempHealthRates.description: Set a health pool's decay rate and absorption rate in one action.

decayRate.name: Decay rate
decayRate.desc: Pool health lost per second (0 = no decay).

absorptionRate.name: Absorption rate
absorptionRate.desc: Pool health lost per 1 point of damage (1.0 = equal, 0.5 = armour-style).

SetupTempHealthPool.display-text: {my}: Setup health pool {0}: amount {1}, decay {2}/s, absorption {3}, priority {4}
SetupTempHealthPool.description: Fully configure a health pool: amount, decay rate, absorption rate and priority.

amount.name: Amount
amount.desc: The pool health amount to set.

decayRate.name: Decay rate
decayRate.desc: Pool health lost per second (0 = no decay).

absorptionRate.name: Absorption rate
absorptionRate.desc: Pool health lost per 1 point of damage (1.0 = equal, 0.5 = armour-style).

priority.name: Priority
priority.desc: Damage absorption priority. Lower numbers are consumed first. Default 0.

IsDead.description: True if the instance is dead (health is 0).

IsEnabled.description: True if the behavior is enabled.

IsInvulnerable.description: True if the instance is currently invulnerable to damage.

OnDamaged.description: Trigger when the instance takes damage.

OnHealed.description: Trigger when the instance is healed.

OnHealthChanged.description: Triggers whenever health changes for any reason (damage, healing, set health, revive, or max health clamp).

OnRevived.description: Triggers when the instance is revived from death.

HasAnyStatus.description: True if any status is currently active.

HasStatus.description: True if the status is currently active.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status to check. Not case-sensitive.

OnAnyStatus.description: Triggers when any status is applied, reapplied, ticks, expires or is removed. Use LastStatus for its name.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Applied: became active. Reapplied: applied while active. Ticked: after each tick. Expired: ran out of time or stacks. Removed: ended for any reason.

OnStatus.description: Triggers when a status is applied, reapplied, ticks, expires or is removed.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status to listen for. Not case-sensitive.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Applied: became active. Reapplied: applied while active. Ticked: after each tick. Expired: ran out of time or stacks. Removed: ended for any reason.

HasAnyTempHealth.description: True if any health pool has health remaining.

HasTempHealth.description: True if the named health pool has health remaining.

type.name: Pool
type.desc: Name of the health pool to check.

IsTempHealthType.description: True if the pool that fired the last pool trigger has this name.

type.name: Pool
type.desc: The pool name to match against the pool that fired the last trigger.

OnTempHealthAbsorbed.description: Triggers when a health pool absorbs incoming damage, even partially.

OnTempHealthAdded.description: Triggers when health is added to a pool. Use LastPoolName for the pool.

OnTempHealthDepleted.description: Triggers when a health pool reaches zero, from damage or decay.

HealthAbsorptionRate.description: The current damage multiplier applied to real health. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = resistance, 2.0 = vulnerability.

HealthPercent.description: Current health as a percentage of max health.

LastDamageStatus.description: Name of the status that caused LastDamage. Empty if the damage was direct.

LastHealStatus.description: Name of the status that caused LastHeal. Empty if the heal was direct.

LastStatus.description: Name of the status that fired the most recent status trigger.

LastTickAmount.description: Amount the most recent status tick tried to apply, before health pools and absorption.

StatusByIndex.description: Name of the active status at a 0-based index, in the order they became active.

StatusDuration.description: Duration the status was last applied with. -1 if permanent, 0 if not active.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status. Not case-sensitive.

StatusRemaining.description: Time remaining on a status, in seconds or turns. -1 if permanent, 0 if not active.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status. Not case-sensitive.

StatusStacks.description: Current stacks of a status. 0 if not active.

name.name: Status
name.desc: Name of the status. Not case-sensitive.

LastPoolDamageAbsorbed.description: Incoming damage absorbed by the pool that fired the last pool trigger.

LastPoolName.description: Name of the health pool that fired the most recent pool trigger.

LastTempDamageAbsorbed.description: Deprecated: use LastPoolDamageAbsorbed. Incoming damage absorbed by the pool that fired the last pool trigger.

LastTempHealthType.description: Deprecated: use LastPoolName. Name of the health pool that fired the most recent pool trigger.

PoolAbsorptionMultiplier.description: Multiplier currently applied to every pool's absorption rate: the global multiplier times every active status's.

PoolAbsorptionRate.description: Pool health lost per 1 point of incoming damage for a named pool. 1 = equal, 0.5 = armour-style.

PoolByIndex.description: Name of the health pool at a 0-based index, in the order pools absorb damage (priority, then creation).

PoolCount.description: Number of health pools on this instance, including empty ones.

PoolDecayRate.description: Pool health lost per second for a named pool.

PoolHealth.description: Current health of a named pool.

PoolPriority.description: Absorption priority of a named pool. Lower numbers absorb first. 0 if the pool does not exist.

TempHealth.description: Deprecated: use PoolHealth. Current health of a named pool.

TempHealthAbsorptionRate.description: Deprecated: use PoolAbsorptionRate. Pool health lost per 1 point of incoming damage for a named pool. 1 = equal, 0.5 = armour-style.

TempHealthDecayRate.description: Deprecated: use PoolDecayRate. Pool health lost per second for a named pool.

TempHealthPriority.description: Deprecated: use PoolPriority. Absorption priority of a named pool. Lower numbers absorb first. 0 if the pool does not exist.
